lemmas.name: div11_ok
lemmas.statement: ∀ (n : Int), (decide (n % 11 = 0) = true → ∃ k : Int, n = 11 * k) ∧ (¬ decide (n % 11 = 0) = true → ∀ k : Int, ¬ n = 11 * k)
lemmas.proof:
by intro n
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : n % 11 = 0 := by simpa using h
    exact ⟨n / 11, by omega⟩
  · intro h k hk
    apply h
    simp
    omega
